title: VanillaWeapons
body:
Longsword:

Tier Base Damage
- Wooden 4 Attack Damage
- Stone 6 Attack Damage
- Iron 8 Attack Damage
- Diamond 10 Attack Damage
- Netherite 12 Attack Damage

By holding Right-Click, the player prepares a heavy strike. Releasing the button triggers a high-damage blow.

Unique Enchants & Traits:

Weighty Blade: When the charged strike hits an enemy, it applies Slowness II for 1.5 seconds, staggering your opponent.

Brave: Decreases slow penalty while charging by 10% each level. Level cap: 3

Scythe:

Tier Base Damage
- Wooden 4.5 Attack Damage
- Stone 6 Attack Damage
- Iron 7.5 Attack Damage
- Diamond 9 Attack Damage
- Netherite 10 Attack Damage

Crouching and hitting a mob pulls them. When you kill a mob, you get 5% of their max HP.

Unique Enchants & Traits:

Gleaner: Mobs killed drop double XP orbs but zero item drops. Ideal for repairing gear without filling your inventory.

Vampirism: Increases HP leech by 2.5% each level. Level cap: 4
